{{Top|leg}}
'''Ulmac''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Ulmac liked using [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptors]] to prove a point by disintegrating objects next to a target to show the seriousness of a situation. If the target refused to cooperate after the display, Ulmac believed they got what they deserved.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

Ulmac once had a [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]] friend of his test the [[KK-5 blaster pistol]] out, only to find that it was wildly inaccurate. In testing, the blaster would miss the target eight out of ten times. Ulmac related the story on the weapon's entry in the Datalog.<ref name="GFT" />
